script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Sci-Fi
Theme: forgiveness

Begin screenplay.

FADE IN:

INT. LAB - NIGHT

DR. LUCAS, mid-40s, brilliant but anxious scientist, tinkers with a holographic machine. He's exhausted but driven.

DR. LUCAS
(whispering to himself)
This has to work. For her...

INT. DR. LUCAS' APARTMENT - NIGHT

A holographic projector hums in the living room as Dr. Lucas paces around nervously, waiting. Suddenly, the image of his deceased wife, EVELYN, appears.

EVELYN
(tearfully)
Lucas, I've missed you so much.

DR. LUCAS
(tearfully)
Evelyn, I've missed you too. I've been trying to find a way to bring you back.

EVELYN
(smiling)
I know. But Lucas, we can't change the past. We must find forgiveness within ourselves.

DR. LUCAS
(sadly)
But I couldn't save you. I couldn't prevent the accident.

EVELYN
(comfortingly)
You weren't to know. Accidents happen, Lucas. We can't control every outcome in life. But we can control how we react. And I forgive you.

INT. LAB - DAY

Dr. Lucas returns to the lab with renewed determination. He no longer focuses on bringing back the dead but instead works on a machine that can help people find inner peace and forgiveness.

INT. SCHOOL - DAY

Principal MCKENNA, late 40s, introduces Dr. Lucas to a group of students who've been experiencing bullying.

PRINCIPAL MCKENNA
(pointing to Dr. Lucas)
This is Dr. Lucas, he's here to help you find inner peace and forgiveness.

INT. DR. LUCAS' OFFICE - DAY

A student, JIMMY, 12, sits nervously across from Dr. Lucas.

JIMMY
(shyly)
I don't think I can forgive him. He stole my lunch money every day for a month.

DR. LUCAS
(reassuringly)
It's okay, Jimmy. Forgiveness isn't about making them feel better. It's about freeing yourself from the anger and pain they've caused you.

INT. LAB - NIGHT

Dr. Lucas works late into the night, perfecting the machine. He's determined to help as many people as possible find forgiveness.

INT. COMMUNITY CENTER - DAY

A crowd gathers around the holographic machine as Dr. Lucas explains its purpose. People from all walks of life share their stories of pain and forgiveness.

INT. DR. LUCAS' APARTMENT - NIGHT

Dr. Lucas sits alone, looking at the holographic image of Evelyn.

EVELYN
(smiling)
I'm proud of you, Lucas. You've helped so many people find peace.

DR. LUCAS
(tearfully)
I wish I could have done the same for you.

EVELYN
(comfortingly)
You have, Lucas. By helping others, you've kept my memory alive. And I forgive you.

INT. LAB - DAY

Dr. Lucas continues to help people find forgiveness, knowing that he's made a difference in their lives.

FADE OUT.

THE END
